behaviour: C1: parseStructured returns null for invite_cancelled / leave_intent whose subject `pubkey` is not canonical 64-char lowercase hex (same guard as member_admitted / invite_lifecycle); such content falls through to plain-text rendering and never reaches pubkeyToNpub.
C2: well-formed announcements (canonical subject pubkey) parse exactly as before.

C3: the avatar imageUrl rules (non-empty string, <= 512 chars, scheme allow-list https:// or //, no whitespace) are a single exported predicate in dmProfile/kinds.ts used by BOTH the 1:1 codec (encode + parse, behaviour unchanged) and marmot/profileSync.ts#payloadToMemberProfile.

C4: payloadToMemberProfile drops (avatar: null) an avatar whose imageUrl -- direct or reconstructed from a legacy id -- fails the predicate, while keeping nickname/updatedAt/signedEvent/pubkey unchanged.
C5: no new authentication scheme, no change to anything published; leave_intent subject==sender binding only if every producer announces its own leave.
non_goals: Actor fields that are never rendered (invite_cancelled.by, poll_open.creatorPubkey, call_notice.initiator) -- renderers attribute from the protocol-authenticated sender.
Announcement spoofability beyond the leave_intent binding (accepted by owner 2026-07-19).
